sourceReview.findings: No blocking action architecture finding in the reviewed frontend source. Existing native widgets and canonical action JSX preserve exact hashes/owners; all fourteen new actions use the local Button facade.
sourceReview.scopePrivacy: PrintingWorkspace remounts on scopeKey/demo; deferred reads and pairing responses check mounted/epoch before exposing scope data. Pairing code is memory-only and cleared on dismiss. Thermal preview uses sandbox iframe and renderer escapes HTML text; QR field is capability-gated and backend token authorization is separate.
sourceReview.formsCopies: Editor supplies shared dirty/pending guard; restoring defaults uses patchValues with shouldDirty/shouldValidate. Copies remain explicit integer1–5, width80mm; reprint starts a new explicitly confirmed intent with manual content, warning about duplicate paper and retained idempotency on failed submission.
sourceReview.roles: Read-only review preserves effectiveCapability route visibility, explicit viewer denial, can_manage/can_print snapshot UI gates and separate existing backend enforcement. No role mirror altered by this audit.
limitations: Source and metadata review only; no full build or hardware test executed by this audit agent.
QR authorization remains a backend responsibility; a locally rendered preview is not proof of an authorized token or physical print.
Browser and production validation are owned by the integrator.

sourceReview.result: APTO: response body consumed once, HTTP status retained on parse/body errors; 401/403 discard data, pairing, forms and preview, advance accessGeneration/epoch and prevent deferred responses from restoring secrets. All616 canonical action JSX/owners and55 reviewed native widget JSX/owners remain exact. No new canonical review or exemption needed.
